review_scope: Task-scoped original use, interpretation review, final-draft acceptance and background acquisition

reviewers.scope: usage, detail verification and regression tests
Observed source/version/hash and final-draft bypass reproduction
Open primary routes, archive provenance and version identity
Background adapter, workflow integration and independent correction of scientific drafts
Authorized selected original passages and corrected final drafts; same model family as the scientific drafter

findings.problem: Catalog hashes alone allowed a locally modified original to retain old review credit.
findings.resolution: Critical source checks rehash actual bytes and reject changed identity, version, role or scope.
findings.verification: Actual-file tamper and stale-anchor regressions pass.

findings.problem: A model could submit a correct interpretation and contradict it in the final draft.
findings.resolution: Independent final-draft hook binds exact text SHA256 and rechecks current source and interpretation revisions after callback.
findings.verification: Contradictory-final, callback failure, revised interpretation and changed-source regressions pass.

findings.problem: Retyping extracted PDF quotes introduced whitespace, mathematical-character and read-ID errors.
findings.resolution: Actual read responses expose passage addresses; the host resolves their original text. Wrong or foreign-session IDs remain rejected.
findings.verification: Passage addressing and cross-session refusal regressions pass; two real cases completed source-bound submissions.

findings.problem: Same-model review missed reversed filtering errors, cross-case contamination and class-versus-correctness confusion.
findings.resolution: Preserve raw drafts, apply independent Codex source/metric curation, add mathematical reference interfaces, and re-review corrected texts.
findings.verification: Final published plans carry new independent review hashes. No general scientific-correctness guarantee is claimed.

findings.problem: Foreground computer use interrupted the researcher's desktop.
findings.resolution: Default background task-owned tab adapter rejects borrowed tabs and has no window-activation or OS-input API.
findings.verification: Cell page interaction and PDF download succeeded through tab-directed background input; adapter regressions reject forbidden/unsupported paths.

findings.problem: Large PDF payloads exceeded a single browser-bridge transfer.
findings.resolution: Transfer bounded chunks with continuous offsets and browser/local SHA256 equality; do not expose partial files as PDFs.
findings.verification: State formal PDF: 27988343 bytes, 54 chunks, matching full digest; corruption/cleanup tests pass.

findings.problem: A shared bioRxiv DOI could collapse v1 and v3 or allow an old posted-date stamp to satisfy a new revision.
findings.resolution: Keep explicit repository revisions and verify known posted-date expectations; preserve old originals.
findings.verification: bioRxiv/medRxiv revision and old-PDF-date regressions pass; DCAF v3 dated 2026-10-31 was imported.

remaining_limits: Independent model verdicts can share systematic errors and are not scientific certificates.
Strict passage anchors cover extracted text; figure-only or skipped content may require original visual reading and remains outside text-anchor proof.
A backend must honor background navigation/input semantics; not every site can be completed unattended.
No scientific benchmark or model-training performance gain has been measured.
